qualification_requirements.attestation_key_requirement: The signer and separately identified confined runner each have their own externally provisioned Ed25519 key. The signer config, catalog, proof verifier, and catalog-to-runner-descriptor binding reject a shared key ID or public key. Catalogs pin both verifier keys, Plan policy artifact hash, and runner descriptor hash; no key, endpoint, repository, or credential belongs in this template.
qualification_requirements.policy_requirement: The signer configuration maps each credential to one client_id, exact signer-descriptor hash, and exact profile grants, pins an external Plan repository/commit and its policy artifact hash, and sets bounded active and per-client retained-proof capacities. The Plan policy pins runner/interpreter/dependency/environment hashes and every test runner/command. The signer and runner each declare a distinct identity and namespace.
qualification_requirements.runner_requirement: The runner descriptor itself pins the exact Plan commit, policy path/hash, and allowed profile IDs. Candidate workloads execute only in that independently provisioned confined runner. Immediately before dispatch the signer obtains a nonce-bound runner identity that rehashes runner/interpreter/dependency identities; its transcript must bind that identity hash and attest rehash-before-dispatch, isolation, hard timeout, output limit, and complete output. No same-process or local Popen fallback exists.
qualification_requirements.retention_requirement: The signer retains a bounded per-client proof/transcript readback. A PASS proof requires the complete runner-signed transcript. S retains one catalog, runner descriptor, and test/migration proof pair for every receipt; X separately retains the same trust artifacts and a review proof whose signed input hashes equal the exact review packet and runner report bytes. The governed role receipt and final review result are produced only after that proof exists.
qualification_requirements.launch_rule: This template is not a service configuration and must not be passed to a launcher, card, or admission gate. Deployment must provision isolated signer and runner identities/namespaces, immutable Plan policy, client and runner credentials, separate keys, and pinned catalog/descriptor artifacts. Until the external runner artifact and configuration are provisioned and observed healthy, W08 review execution is a truthful HOLD, never locally emulated.
